name: What steps are involved in an interior renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in an interior renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior renovation project typically follows several stages. It begins with initial consultation and design planning, including material selection. Next, permits are secured, if necessary. Demolition and structural work (if any) then occur, followed by rough-ins for electrical and plumbing. Insulation and drywall installation precede flooring, cabinetry, and finish carpentry. Finally, painting, fixture installation, and a thorough cleanup complete the project. Throughout, quality control checks are performed to ensure standards are met.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation steps include consultation, design, permitting, demolition, rough-ins (electrical/plumbing), drywall, flooring, cabinetry, painting, and final fixtures.
